marketing_description: The SATCO® S3539 incandescent bulb delivers 300 lumens of warm white light at 2700 K, with a 20 W power output and a 2.13‑inch tube shape. Its clear glass finish, halogen pin base T4, and 360‑degree beam provide uniform illumination, while the 120 V rating and dimmable feature allow flexible installation. With a 2000‑hour average life and a CRI of 100, this bulb meets the performance needs of commercial lighting applications.
